_comment: LEVEL 5 (stack): COMPLETE production deploy in ONE call — observability + error tracking + health ready for going live. No new code: pure composition.
name: stack-prod
description: Complete production going-live: structured logging + error tracking (Sentry) + health/readiness + audit trail + ops dashboard + security headers, plus CI/gate/deploy. One call = full production deploy skeleton.

variables.name: sentry_dsn
variables.description: Sentry DSN env value (optional — when empty, error tracking runs in log-only mode)

notes: Production going-live starter. Structured logging, error tracking, health checks, audit trail, ops dashboard, and security headers come pre-wired plus CI/gate/deploy + staging gate. Tiers: Tier 1 fast-checks (30s, no infra, every PR/push) → Tier 2 staging.yml (10 live integration jobs — backup drill, N-1, rotation, multi-worker, DNS/TLS, external smoke, k6, live smoke; push to the staging-level branch, graceful-skip when STAGING_URL absent) → Tier 3 release-heavy (image/SBOM/zizmor/migration/oasdiff on prod pushes + tags v*) → deploy/prod. After apply: set SENTRY_DSN + JWT_SECRET in .env, set vars.STAGING_URL for staging, import new models in main.py so tables create, app.include_router for ops-health/logs/errors/audit routers, docker compose up --build, nginx TLS via certbot.
